verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a real-time tax estimate endpoint (POST /v1/tax/estimate) that factors in nexus, product taxability, exemptions, and shipping address, explicitly built for checkout flows and idempotent for testing, plus an address suggestion/validation endpoint supporting rooftop-level accuracy. However there's no independent benchmark or hands-on evidence of latency/performance suitable for checkout, and no explicit confirmation the address validation feeds precise rooftop coordinates versus jurisdiction-level lookup. missing for 10: independent latency/performance benchmarks, explicit confirmation of rooftop (not just jurisdiction) geocoding precision, third-party corroboration of accuracy claims.
